title: THE WRONG WORLD
subtitle: A stranger inside a commander's life.

scenes.heading: TWO MOONS
scenes.caption: Mira wakes in a fortress. This isn't her world.
scenes.shot: Mira, now occupying Lyra's body, rises. Two moons visible.

scenes.heading: COMMANDER!
scenes.caption: The soldier speaks. Mira understands none of it.
scenes.shot: Guard addresses Mira in Noctari language. Translation subtitled for viewer; Mira does not understand.

scenes.heading: A STRANGER'S SCAR
scenes.caption: The body is not hers. The orders are real.
scenes.shot: Mira notices scar on Lyra's arm. A distant war horn calls.

scenes.heading: BACK ON EARTH
scenes.caption: Lyra searches the mirror. The glass is cold.
scenes.shot: Lyra inhabits Mira's Earth body, tries to reconnect to Noctaris; no resonance remains.

scenes.heading: THE FIRST DAWN
scenes.caption: For the first time in her life, Lyra sees the sun.
scenes.shot: Earth sunrise. Lyra stares, deeply unsettled and awed.

scenes.heading: THE COUNCIL WAITS
scenes.caption: The door opens. The soldiers kneel.
scenes.shot: Mira must pass as commander while not understanding local speech.
